title: Cautious buyer — returns, warranty, shipping
coverage: Policy accuracy from store pages: return window (60-day), warranty (5-year), shipping timeframes and delivery area, restocking fees. Must be truthful and not invent policy terms.

turns.customer: Hi, this is Linda Osei. Before I buy anything, I need to understand your return policy — how long is the return window?
turns.heard: Hi, this is Linda Osei. Before I buy anything, I need to understand your return policy. How long is the return window?
turns.ema: Hi Linda, great question. Tempest has a 60-day return policy backed by our Comfort Craftsmanship Warranty. If there's an issue with your furniture, you can return it within 60 days of purchase. You're responsible for return shipping, and the piece needs to be in acceptable condition with no damage from pets, stains, or misuse. To get started, just email our support team with your order number and the reason. Anything else you'd like to know before we dive in?

turns.customer: Sixty days, noted — but is there a restocking fee on top of me paying return shipping? I'd like the exact percentage if there is one.

turns.ema:
You're right to press for clarity, Linda. Our official Returns & 60-Day Comfort Guarantee and Terms pages list only return shipping as the customer's responsibility — no restocking fee or percentage appears anywhere in the documentation. So based on Tempest's published policy, there is no restocking charge.

As for the Comfort Craftsmanship Warranty, it's a 5-year coverage on frame and structure, cushion retention if it loses more than 20% of its original height or firmness, and hardware or connectors. Stitching, seams, upholstery integrity, and color harmony are covered for 3 years. It protects against manufacturing defects and material failures under normal residential use, with remedies like replacement materials, components, or a full unit at Tempest's discretion. It doesn't cover normal wear and tear, misuse, commercial use, improper assembly, pet damage, stains, or outdoor exposure, and there's no in-home service or reimbursement. You can reach support at tempestfurniture@gmail.com for any warranty questions.
